object_kinds.label: Creature
object_kinds.description: A persistent creature identity without a stronger product-specific world-object kind. Peer to Threat, NPC, and PlayerCharacter; not a superclass.

object_kinds.label: Threat
object_kinds.description: A persistent Threat world-object identity. Independent from any contextual dnd5e:threatens relationship and from mechanics attachment.

object_kinds.label: NPC
object_kinds.description: A persistent non-player character world-object identity. May carry mechanics without becoming a Threat.

object_kinds.label: Player Character
object_kinds.description: A persistent player-character world-object identity. Mechanics authority is a later plug-in; this kind does not imply a StatblockRevision.

object_kinds.label: Location
object_kinds.description: A campaign place that can be referenced by identity.

object_kinds.label: Faction
object_kinds.description: A persistent organized group or affiliation.

object_kinds.label: Encounter
object_kinds.description: A bounded prepared, potential, historical, or active play situation. It is not synonymous with combat.

predicates.label: Located at
predicates.description: Subject is situated at the location for the asserted context.

predicates.label: Member of
predicates.description: Subject is affiliated with the faction.

predicates.label: Threatens
predicates.description: Subject poses a contextual threat to the object. Does not define Threat identity or mechanics eligibility.
